item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
I always liked this one, the sad thing is that it makes the thing into a yet another violent compulsion.
I think the way to save this one is scratch that and instead focus on the words themselves
Over the last few days, I was reading the 1811 Dictionary of Vulgar Tongue (public domain, and dearly recommended) and the thing is, instead of just an explanation of meaning, quite often the book delves into both origins of phrases and brief explanations to how things are done , say

BISHOPED, or TO BISHOP. A term used among horse-dealers, for
burning the mark into a horse's tooth, after he has
lost it by age; by bishoping, a horse is made to appear
younger than he is. It is a common saying of milk that is
burnt too, that the bishop has set his foot in it. Formerly,
when a bishop passed through a village, all the inhabitants
ran out of their houses to solicit his blessing, even leaving
their milk, &c. on the fire, to take its chance: which, went
burnt to, was said to be bishoped.

Now, suppose that the word-a-day calendar was similar - most of the made-up words are plain made up, say

to breznev (v) - cover with a thick metal plating, after L.I.Breznev , General Secretary of CPSU known for wearing an excessively large amount of medals"

while a small amount might reveal sensitive information such as

Fiffle Stinks (n) - a fifthist worshipper, from their tendency to turn themselves into sentient smoke. He's full of it like a tent's full of Fiffle Stinks - said to a bullshitter.

and even smaller amount actively, though not in detail describe how to do things which are impossible according to what we know, eg

gobsacking (v) - A trick usually done by hungry college students which goes as follows - a number of them . usually 12 will meet and [REDACTED] to create an extradimensional pocket inside the mouth of one of them - the gobsack. The fellows will then pool their cash for an "all you can eat" pizza place entry for the gobsack, who goes inside, and artfully "eats" as much pizza as he deems enough for the group, stuffing it into the pocket without chewing. The rest of the group awaits him outside , where they will [REDACTED] and partake in the loot.

That would be a hell of a reason to contain it, and depending on how clever the list of words someone makes is, might be an interesting entry.
